rejections.not_a_colour: Expected: a colour written #rrggbb, six digits or letters from a to f after the hash (example: #1f6feb).
rejections.level_refused: This value is not set at this level: set it where it is offered.
rejections.invalid_late_fee_tiers: Up to five fees separated by semicolons, each an amount or a percentage of what is still owed (example: 5; 10; 2%).
rejections.invalid_reminder_stages: Up to five numbers of days late, three digits at most each, separated by commas (example: 7, 15, 30).
rejections.invalid_reference_format: Unaccented letters, digits and . _ / - around exactly one {SEQ} or {SEQ:n}, n from 1 to 12 (example: ART-{SEQ:5}).
rejections.invalid_unit_code: A unit code has 2 or 3 capital letters or digits (example: C62 for a piece, KGM for a kilogram).
rejections.invalid_whatsapp: A WhatsApp number is written in international form: + then the country code and the number, in digits and spaces only (example: +216 20 123 456).
rejections.invalid_phone_digits: A phone number holds 6 to 15 digits, with + before the country code if it has one (example: +216 71 900 868).
rejections.invalid_status_url: The status page's address starts with https:// then the site's name (example: https://status.example.com).
